notes.title: New skill, mission timers, optimization, and more in Causa Update 1.0.7.
notes.notes:
As every week, a new update of Causa is available! Read the details of the [b]Patch Notes 1.0.7[/b] below: 

[list]
[*] The [b]server[/b] was upgraded. 

[*] We added a timer to indicate when the [b]next Daily and Weekly Missions[/b] will be assigned.

[*] We added a timer to indicate when the player will be able to [b]replace a Mission[/b]. 

[*] The keyword [b]Aggressive [/b]was removed. 

[*] The keyword [b]Rush[/b] was added: It may Attack enemy Characters the turn in enters into play.

[*] The assets of [b]gameplay effects[/b] were optimized. 

[*] Minor game updates: The art of the “[b]Organite Expert[/b]” was updated, and the Leader Decision of Fadun is now called “[b]Elyrian Forge[/b]” instead of “Talarian Tools”.

[*] The following cards were [b]redesigned[/b]: 
[/list]

[b]Raging Soldier[/b], from “Aggressive”, to “Rush. Initiative: Deal 1 Damage to your opponent”. 

[b]Ashensoul Soldier[/b], from “Aggressive. Ashensoul”, to “Rush. Ashensoul. Initiative: Deal 1 Damage to your opponent”. 

[b]Brave Settler[/b], from “Aggressive”, to “Rush”. Green Razorback, from “Vigilant. Aggressive”, to “Vigilant. Rush”. 

[b]Vile Zealot[/b], from “Aggressive. Initiative: Deal 1 Damage to all Leaders”, to “Initiative: Deal 2 Damage to All Leaders”. 

[b]Furious Charge[/b], from granting “Aggressive”, to grant “Rush”. Lenician Brawler, from “Expend 2”, to “Expend 1”. 

[b]Sabotage Contract[/b], from “Expend 2”, to “Expend 1”. 

[b]Grotty Tavern[/b], from “At the start of your turn, Heal 1 to your Mercenaries and give them +1 Attack”, to “When you play a Mercenary, give it +1 Attack and Gather 1”. 

[b]Battle[/b], from “Destroy All Characters with Attack 1 or less, then give +1 Attack to your Characters”, to “Deal 2 Damage to All Characters with Attack 1 or less, then give +1 Attack to your Characters”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/d6fd70b6406f37cf42bac082733d3e77e63e6615.jpg[/img]

We're just one [url=https://playcausa.com]Founders Soulember Bundle[/url] away from unlocking [b]a free avatar for everyone[/b], so make sure to join the [url=https://playcausa.com/discord]Causa Discord Server[/url] to be aware of this awesome moment. Also, the design of the upcoming Ranked Mode is being discussed, so it's a great time to [url=https://playcausa.com/discord]join the chat[/url]!

Don't forget the dev team goes [url=https://twitch.tv/playcausa]live on Twitch[/url] every Thursday at 5 pm Eastern Time. Come hang out with us!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2, and Special Early Access Bundle Announced
notes.notes:
It's been [b]2 amazing weeks of Early Access[/b]! Thank you very much for playing Causa, as well as for all your support and feedback.

There's still a LONG WAY to go to keep improving the game, but so far we're very glad we have reached over [b]2,000 new players accounts, and 124 user reviews[/b], with an overall Very Positive score. We've also gathered TONS of constructive feedback through the Steam Community Hub and the [url=https://playcausa.com/discord]Causa Discord Server[/url].

We wanted to let you know we've just released an update that includes [b]significant changes in the game balance.[/b] Here's the details of the version 1.0.2: 

[list]
[*] We increased [b]the odds of obtaining Legendary Cards[/b], from 1% to 1.7%.

[*] The [b]difficulty of the Daily Missions[/b] was lowered, so they are easier to accomplish. 

[*] To foster the PvP Mode, [b]vs IA now grants 25% of the experience granted by PvP matches[/b], instead of 50%.

[*] "Fatigue" is now called [b]"Despair"[/b], to fit the lore of Causa better.

[*] We changed the [b]Level of the Leader's Decisions[/b]: Uko, from 2-3-5 to 2-3-6; Bara, from 2-3-4 to 2-3-5; Nilset, from 2-3-6 to 2-4-6; Danu, from 2-3-6 to 2-4-6; and Ralkán, from 2-5-6 to 2-4-6.

[*] We changed the [b]Black Market Agent[/b] skill, from “When you draw a card due to an effect, deal 1 Damage to your opponent”, to “At the end of each turn, if you control two or more Supports, your opponent Expends 1”. [i]Note:[/i] We loved the suggestion of adding the hitting himself effect. So we'll design a new card from another archetype to do that. This change should help the Milling Wealth strategies.

[*] We changed the [b]War Drums[/b] from: Level 6, 1 Use, “Use: Give +1 Attack and Aggressive to your Characters”, to Level 5, No Uses, “Your Characters have +1 Attack”.

[*] The [b]following cards were nerfed:[/b] Desert Blade (Gains +3 Attack instead of +4); Barcajali Brute (Health 4 instead of 5); Officiant of the Flame (Health 2 instead of 3); Intimidation (Level 4 instead of 3); Sumkala Disciple (Health 2 instead of 3); Official Safe-Conduct (Level 3 instead of 2); Sister of Mourne (Health 4 instead of 5); Grotty Tavern (Level 6 instead of 4).

[*] The [b]following cards were buffed:[/b] Highway Assault (Expends 1 instead of 2); Envoy of Ciadel (Level 4 instead of 5).

[*] We [b]fixed the bug that enables the Ranked button[/b] after leaving the Campaign Section. 

[*] We added the [b]"Repeat e-mail" and "Repeat password"[/b] fields in the Registration, to avoid issues when registering new accounts. 
[/list]

Regarding what we'll be working on next, a few days ago we asked the community on [url=https://twitter.com/playcausa]Twitter[/url] [b]what features/modes they're looking forward to the most[/b], and what they think should be added to the game first. The results were the following: 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/c4e099e92903cb6c8853eabf01678bbf6d6a451d.jpg[/img]


However, the discussion on Twitter and [url=https://playcausa.com/discord]Discord[/url] was even more enlightening than the voting itself. We'll let you know [b]how all this impacts our development plans[/b] very soon!

Apart from the upcoming features, our current top priority is to [b]improve the game stability, and fix connection/matchmaking issues[/b]. If you encounter any problem on this area, please share the details with us. This will help us identify and solve the problem.

Finally, alongisde the free codes and rewards we've announced so far - which you may find on the [url=https://discord.gg/HNGX4KH]#freebies channel[/url] of our Discord Server -, today we're also revealing a new Early Access Bundle available for purchase on our [url=https://playcausa.com]official website[/url]: the [b]Founders Soulember! [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/def96246051deda9e14b3bf98a1db1d991602506.jpg[/img]


This is a special, limited-stock offer aimed for the Early Access players who'd like to [b]support the development of Causa and its community[/b]. For USD $60, this bundles includes: 
[list]
[*] 50 Card Packs. 
[*] 3,500 Organite.
[*] 1 Exclusive Founders Soulember Card Back
[*] 1 Exclusive Founders Soulember Banner
[*] 2 Exclusive Titles: Founder, and Dawnbringer  
[*] 10 Avatars (see image below)
[*] Sponsor 1 Free Card Pack for everyone during 2 weeks! 
[/list]

That's right! We'll create a [b]unique Card Pack code highlighting your username[/b], to be included among the other freebies available for everyone on our Discord during a 2-week period. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/86d907564854ee79bf3898ab981ffac7c071bbe9.png[/img]


We hope to be back with more updates and surprises soon! If you have any questions or feedback, please reach out to us on [url=https://playcausa.com/discord]Discord[/url], and the Steam Community Hub.

Have wonderful rest of the week!

notes.title: Free Soulember to craft up to 10 Legendary Cards, and Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing Causa and for all your valuable feedback during this first week of Early Access! 

Today we’re presenting the [b]Update 1.0.1 of Causa[/b], which includes a major surprise aimed to improve your experience and progression in the game:

[b]All users - existing and new - will be assigned free Soulember to craft up to 10 Legendary Cards. [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/5c71bb1081203b55353544f853677d60b576b39b.jpg[/img]


Considering the other recent changes to the game’s economy, we expect this free Soulember to give a [b]huge boost to your Card Collection[/b]. 

We’re also simplifying the Soulember counter, so your Soulember and all the costs are divided by 10 - this is why you’ll see 6,000 new Soulember in your account, but also 10 times cheaper costs in the Card Crafting section. 

Summing these and other changes up, here are the [b]Patch Notes for version 1.0.1:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Free Soulember to craft up to 10 Legendary Cards[/b] assigned to new and existing players.
[*] [b]Soulember amounts simplified[/b] on the game’s client - the proportion was divided by 10, so you’ll see 6,000 new Soulember in your account, and all card crafting costs divided by 10.
[*] We [b]increased the reward of the Weekly Missions[/b] from 600 to 1,000 Gold. 
[*] [b]Consumed cads now produce more Soulember[/b] - a total of one third of their original value. 
[*] We added a [b]clear timer per turn[/b] for the PVP matches.
[*] The [b]visualization of the player’s experience and levels[/b] was modified in the Missions and Profile sections.
[*] We fixed the bug that [b]allowed Characters to be healed beyond their current maximum Resistance[/b], even though it was previously set to an specific value by an effect.
[*] We fixed the bug that prevented players from [b]finding casual matches after playing a Custom match[/b].
[/list]

We look forward to your feedback to keep improving the game. If you like, you may join us on the official [url=https://discord.gg/2mjq7TT]Causa Discord[/url], and leave us your comments and questions on the Steam Community Hub, 

We hope you enjoy the game! Have a wonderful day.

notes.title: Exclusive Early Access Card Back Reveal and Small Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hey, 

Thank you very much for playing Causa and for all your valuable feedback during these first days of Early Access. We’re very glad about the reception of the game so far.

Today, we have an important reveal! Here’s the [b]Special Early Access Card Back: Founders Organite[/b] - a cool item you’ll be able to [b]get exclusively by playing during the Early Access of Causa. [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/4e87f1486212c00c89523c770d7a51b7f292fb8c.png[/img]


This special item will be given to all Causa [b]players who get to Level 10 on all the four powers[/b] in Causa: Glory, Wealth, Influence, and Spirit. 

To claim this reward, you just need to [b]share a screenshot of your achievement on the #founders-rewards channel of the official [url=https://discord.gg/2mjq7TT]Causa Discord server[/url].[/b] The dev team will get back to you with this exclusive reward through DM. 

We'd also like to announce the creation of the [b]#freebies channel[/b] on our [url=https://discord.gg/2mjq7TT]Discord server[/url], in which you'll be able to [b]check the currently available codes to redeem for free gifts in-game.[/b] A great opportunity to boost your collection with free card packs and more! 

Additionally, considering all your feedback, we've made a small update, with some [b]changes in the game economy to improve your progression[/b] in Causa: 
[list]
[*] The rewards for the daily, weekly, and level missions have been improved. 
[*] The reward for each Victory in PvP matches has been upgraded from 15 to 25.
[*] Consumed cards now produce more Soulember, which accelerates the possibilities of card crafting: 
[b]Common:[/b] from 20 to 30 Soulember. 
[b]Rare:[/b] from 80 to 150 Soulember. 
[b]Epic:[/b] from 500 to 750 Soulember 
[b]Legendary:[/b] from 2,000 to 2,500 Soulember
[*] Crafting Legendary Cards is now cheaper. It takes 6,000 instead of 6,500 Soulember. 
[*] Cosmetic items are now only available for Organite. 
[/list]

We also included some [b]technical improvements and bug fixing: [/b]
[list]
[*] Small change to the Consume and Create buttons in the Card Crafting Menu. There's no need to hold the button to Create and Consume. You can cancel the process by clicking again while it loads.
[*] The bug that caused a problem with how the pages of the Collection were displayed was corrected. 
[*] The Glossary was corrected: now it is displayed on different languages, and only the current keywords.
[*] We implemented a temporary solution for the bug that causes a card from your hand to be stuck on your cursor. Please press Alt + tab to change the window, and then come back to the game; or click outside the window and come back to the game (for windowed mode).
[*] A small graphic change: the amounts of Gold and Organite needed to buy Card Packs is outside the Purchase button.
[/list]

We're still organizing all your feedback, and will be attentive to everything you can tell us during the coming days. We’ll start sharing patch notes from now on! 

Don’t forget to join the official [url=https://discord.gg/2mjq7TT]Causa Discord[/url] or leave us your feedback on the Causa [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1034040/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url]. 

We hope you enjoy the game! Have a wonderful week.

notes.title: Dev Update | March 2020: Here's what we've been working on.
notes.notes:
Hey! We hope you’re doing great during these hectic times. 

On our side, we’ve been eager to share with you the details about [b]our progress during the last stage of development[/b] of the strategy card game Causa, Voices the Dusk. As you may know, big news are on the way!

As is often the case in game development, during the final stages of a project [b]programmers[/b] tend to have multiple tasks to fulfill. This is why during the past few weeks our team has been focusing on optimizing the game, identifying and fixing bugs, implementing visual improvements, and developing a few pending features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/03a4fd9fcd9cc6a66598aa0d4b614633fa62624f.png[/img]

For instance, our programmer Boris “Satabolik” has been implementing [b]a redesign of the market in Causa.[/b] It will be quite different from what you experienced during the Demo Weekend last November: Card packs will only be available for purchase with Gold - the currency you gain by playing. Also, only limited amounts of Soulember - the material used in card crafting - will be available for purchase. With these changes, we’re aiming to give players more control over the content they acquire, and therefore avoid any Pay2Win element in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/a6c83016789b36b39618bf8a0fb1049e00b15ddb.jpg[/img]

In terms of [b]game design and script writing[/b], during the past few weeks we’ve been working on designing and implementing Causa’s second Campaign. Our goal is to offer at least two campaigns, with seven playable episodes each, when Causa finally goes live. 

Alongside this, we’re currently polishing [b]the flavor texts that will accompany each Leader, card, and gameplay background.[/b] These are extremely important elements to present the vast and exotic fantasy setting in which the events of the game take place.  

We’ll soon resume the [b]game balance[/b], therefore, we’ll be working side by side with the amazing group of experienced players that have joined the adventure of developing Causa as testers. Make sure to join our official [url=https://discord.gg/2mjq7TT]Discord server[/url] to chat with them and the rest of our team!

In the areas of [b]art, animation, music,  and sound design[/b], we’ve been working on adapting the assets to optimize the game, polish the details that are required to offer an overall smooth and engaging game experience, and other surprises we’ll reveal soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/b1ea8cc62782790af3aab1c099ccc51c4f8532c5.jpg[/img]

Greetings from the Causa team! 

We'll soon be back with more news and updates! In the meantime, make sure to [url=https://playcausa.com/subscribe]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to learn about our latest news, and stay tuned to our social channels for more updates! notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34935535/e3cbb8715c01d127f82e423b8721728b6a4cf0fd.jpg[/img]

Hi! 

We hope you're enjoying Causa in its Closed Beta. [b]We really appreciate you're trying out the game, as well as all the valuable feedback[/b] you're sharing with us. ːsteamhappyː

We wanted to let you know that we recently released a new patch of the game, which includes the following improvements:
